## Summary
- Describe the problem and the approach taken.

## Checklist
- [ ] Tests added/updated and passing locally.
- [ ] Documentation updated (README/ROADMAP/CHANGELOG as needed).
- [ ] Screenshots or logs added for user-facing changes.
- [ ] Risk assessed (data quality, deployment, operational impact).

## Validation
- [ ] `make lint`
- [ ] `make typecheck`
- [ ] `make test`
- [ ] `make demo` (or explanation why skipped)

## Risks and rollback
- What can go wrong?
- How can this be rolled back safely?
